rows.description: A young employee raises an issue with facts, in private, framed around the shared goal. They pick their moment and accept that some cultures will not change quickly.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 18–22

rows.description: An employee who finds the values of a workplace impossible to live with weighs their options and plans a calm exit. Staying and shrinking is a slower loss than leaving with dignity.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 18–22

rows.description: A colleague who keeps commitments, credits others and avoids gossip gains quiet influence. Reputation built on reliability outlasts favours built on manoeuvring.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 18–22

rows.subtype: Sharing a loss in class or family [Receiver]
rows.description: A child sees adults crying at a death in the family or school. They absorb how grief is shown, and being included in simple, honest ways helps more than being shielded.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Joy of festival and team victory [Actor]
rows.description: A child in a Diwali, Eid, Christmas or match-winning crowd feels a joy that is bigger than their own. Shared celebration creates a sense of being part of something.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A school loses a classmate and everyone feels shock, guilt and awkwardness at once. Teenagers grieve differently, some crying, some joking, some silent, and none of it is wrong.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: sadness, grief, embarrassment, guilt

rows.description: A teenager who is grieving or excluded watches others celebrate and feels doubly alone. Communal joy can sharpen personal sorrow.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: joy, sadness, grief

rows.description: A young adult takes part in a vigil, memorial or funeral rites and finds comfort in doing the same acts as others. Ritual gives shape to feelings that have no words.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Noticing a friend not joining in [Observer]
rows.description: A friend sees someone quiet in the middle of a celebration. A soft check-in, without pushing them to feel happy, shows care and respects their pace.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Grieving in a family with different styles [Actor]
rows.description: A family member grieves quietly while another wants to talk and another keeps busy with tasks. Each thinks the other is not grieving properly, and understanding different styles reduces hurt.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
